steps.label: Check if they respond
steps.text: Make sure it is safe. Tap their shoulder and shout, "Are you OK?"

steps.label: Shout for help and call
steps.text: If they do not respond, shout for help. Ask someone to call emergency services and bring an AED. This screen can guide an emergency call.

steps.label: Check breathing
steps.text: Look at their chest for no more than 10 seconds. If they are not breathing, or only gasping, start CPR.

steps.label: Hands on the center of the chest
steps.text: Lay them on their back on a firm surface. Put the heel of one hand on the center of the chest. Put your other hand on top.

steps.label: Push hard and fast
steps.text: Push hard and fast, at least 2 inches deep, with the beat. Let the chest come back up after each push.

steps.label: Keep going until help or an AED arrives
steps.text: Keep pushing with the beat. Do not stop until help takes over, an AED is ready, or they start breathing.

questions.text: Do they respond when you tap them and shout?
